acceptance.given: A disposable package variant has frozen independent expected outcomes for the declared SKILL.md logical-line limit and rule behavior; the repository policy and schemas are copied unchanged into its inspection root.

oracle.expected: Changing the declared limit, removing a required rule, or making validation ignore the copied policy/schema causes the independent expected outcomes to detect the drift; the 499-pass and 500/501-fail boundary remains determined by frozen expected values.
forbidden: An ignored policy or schema goes undetected.
Expected values, thresholds, or required rules are loaded from the candidate policy/schema under test.
oracle.observable: Structured results from the real validator call for the independently constructed drift variants, compared with frozen expected outcomes.

acceptance.then: The independent outcomes detect each policy, schema, limit, or rule drift without deriving their expectations from the candidate artifacts.
acceptance.when: Run the exact A04 pytest selector against the real validate_package entry, using disposable inspection roots containing the copied policy/schema bytes and independently frozen expected values.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a04 must fail with an AssertionError when a changed line limit, dropped rule, or ignored policy/schema is not detected by the independent expected outcomes.

slice_hint.behavior_change: The validator consumes the declared policy and schemas, and independent frozen outcomes detect changes to limits or rules and ignored normative artifacts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent runtime state is changed; preserve the declared policy/schema and result contract versions when reverting the validator behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Independent checks move from unspecified drift detection to detecting changed limits, dropped rules, and ignored policy/schema artifacts.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A04 selector detects each specified drift using independent expected outcomes, while the unchanged normative artifacts and reference package remain valid under the declared terminal suite.
